keywords: Glamsterdam EIP 批量移至 Review
EIP-2780 状态相关费用移到运行时
EIP-8037 账户创建按访问条件收费
summary: poojaranjan 为一批 Glamsterdam EIP 提交移至 Review 的 PR，包括 ePBS（7732）、BAL（7928）、8037、8038、7778 等，其中 7954、7976、7997 当天合并。EIP-2780 把所有依赖状态的费用移到运行时，固有 gas 只保留打包交易的最低成本；EIP-8037 把 CREATE/CREATE2 的账户创建改为在目标访问时按条件收费。两者都已合并。EIP-8141 的细节修正也合并：frame 外调用 frame 相关操作码会异常终止，数据按实际字节而非 RLP 编码计费。

items.topic: 交易 gas 的重新划分
items.title: EIP-2780：把依赖状态的费用移到运行时（冷访问附加费、新账户状态 gas）
items.note: （rakita）合并。固有 gas 变为把交易放进区块所需的最低成本；账户访问拆成固有阶段的 `WARM_ACCESS`（与状态无关的底价）加运行时的冷访问附加费，创建交易的新账户状态 gas 改为运行时按条件收取。
items.title_en: EIP-2780: move state-dependent charges to runtime (cold surcharge, new-account state gas)
items.note_en: (rakita), merged. Intrinsic gas becomes the bare minimum needed to include a transaction in a block; account access splits into an intrinsic `WARM_ACCESS` (a state-independent floor) plus a runtime cold surcharge, and the create transaction's new-account state gas is charged conditionally at runtime.

items.topic: 交易 gas 的重新划分
items.title: EIP-8037：在访问时按条件收取账户创建费
items.note: （chfast）合并。用在目标地址唯一一次访问（同时做 EIP-7610 碰撞检查，EIP-7928 已记录该访问）时按条件收费，取代 CREATE/CREATE2 先无条件收费再退还的模型；余额、nonce、深度检查失败的创建不读目标、不收费，目标已存在（如预先注资的确定性部署地址）也不收费。
items.title_en: EIP-8037: charge account creation conditionally at access
items.note_en: (chfast), merged. A conditional charge at the single destination access that also performs the EIP-7610 collision check (an access EIP-7928 already records) replaces the unconditional-charge-with-refill model for CREATE/CREATE2; creations failing balance, nonce or depth checks never read the destination and pay nothing, and pre-existing destinations (such as pre-funded deterministic deployment addresses) pay nothing either.

items.topic: 交易 gas 的重新划分
items.title: EIP-8141：细节修正
items.note: （lightclient）提交并合并：在 frame 交易上下文之外调用 frame 相关操作码会异常终止；按实际数据而非 RLP 编码计费。
items.note_en: (lightclient), submitted and merged: calling frame-related opcodes outside a frame transaction context is an exceptional halt, and data is charged as actual data, not RLP encoded.

keywords_en: Glamsterdam EIPs moved to Review in bulk
EIP-2780 state-dependent charges moved to runtime
EIP-8037 conditional account creation charge at access
summary_en: poojaranjan submitted PRs moving a batch of Glamsterdam EIPs to Review, including ePBS (7732), BAL (7928), 8037, 8038 and 7778; 7954, 7976 and 7997 were merged the same day. EIP-2780 moves every state-dependent charge to runtime, leaving intrinsic gas as the bare minimum to include a transaction, and EIP-8037 now charges CREATE/CREATE2 account creation conditionally at the destination access. Both were merged. EIP-8141 fixes were merged too: frame-related opcodes halt outside a frame transaction, and data is charged by actual bytes rather than the RLP encoding.
